item.title: SEN TIM SHEEHY: Gold Star families deserve justice. This $15B from Iran is a start
item.summary: Terrorism victims led by 1st Lt. Jacob Fritz's mother seek billions in Iranian Bitcoin, facing opposition from a U.S. attorney in New York federal court.

item.title: Florida officials warned to avoid reparations-style effort as state gears up to restrict DEI even further
item.summary: Leon County, Florida risked losing $16.8 million in grants by pursuing a historical harms measure, according to county staff warning about anti-DEI law SB1134 compliance.

item.title: Air Force is 'smallest,' 'least ready' in history, National Guard leaders warn Congress in fighter jet plea
item.summary: Air National Guard generals request between 72 and 100 new fighter jets, warning the Air Force faces its worst readiness in its 78-year history.

item.title: Man, woman killed in rip current as lifeguard shortage leaves danger zones in beach destination
item.summary: Florida's Space Coast faces a critical lifeguard shortage with 45 unfilled roles as two adults die in a Cocoa Beach rip current while saving a child.

item.title: Influencer’s safari getaway turns deadly days after proposal as police question fiancé, family demands answers
item.summary: Influencer Ashly Robinson, also known as Ashlee Jenae, died in Zanzibar after a reported misunderstanding with her fiancé, authorities say in probe.

item.title: Iranian women's soccer players granted asylum in Australia say they dream of continuing careers 'in safety'
item.summary: Two Iranian women's soccer players speak out for the first time since accepting asylum in Australia, saying they plan to continue their careers in safety.

item.title: Reese Witherspoon warns AI is three times more likely to replace women
item.summary: Reese Witherspoon urged women to learn how to use AI, warning that their jobs are three times more likely to be replaced by artificial intelligence than men's.

item.title: Australia's most decorated veteran walks free on bail on war crimes charges related to Afghan deaths
item.summary: Australia's most decorated living veteran Ben Roberts-Smith was released on bail after being charged with war crime murder over killings in Afghanistan.

item.title: Doctors in training learn cooking skills to help patients amid America's chronic disease crisis
item.summary: Future doctors are learning to prepare healthy, flavorful meals and turn nutrition advice into patient guidance in new culinary medicine programs at medical schools.
